messages:
maria: quick flag we're seeing auth exchanges that return project_id="-" for svc-bridge tokens. Routing treats that as a real project and bumps org ratebands.

jon: when did this start? any recent change to the exchange service?

maria: started ~2026-02-28 22:40 UTC after a refactor that changed missing-claim handling.

ravi: log sample: 
```
2026-02-28T22:41:03Z exchange INFO token=tok_svc bridge_user=svc-bridge project_id=- origin=partner-proxy
```

tia: policy-wise we should map sentinel values ("-", "null", "") to a non-billable orphan bucket before routing. Quick patch would be in auth-router.

jon: agree. I'll prepare a canary patch to normalize project IDs. Also will add a Prom metric auth_orphan_total.

maria: add dashboard tile too. show orphan tokens by partner and model, plus top affected orgs (so we can notify them).

ravi: also flag telemetry: add label attribution_fix=true when we normalize so we can backfill attribution later.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-01T02:00:00Z -> auth-router:v2.1-canary

jon: PR #9124 opened with normalization + tests.

tia: alert: if orphan_pct > 0.5% for 30m -> page eng-platform.

maria: thanks folks. we'll revert policy if any false positives.
